home.headline: APEX TRADING GROUP
home.tagline: The Premier Student Investment Organization at the Ross School of Business
home.intro: Since our founding in 2014, Apex Trading Group (ATG) has empowered students with rigorous finance education through a student-run investment portfolio. Members gain valuable insights through educational sessions and stock pitches, fostering both practical skills and professional growth. We create an interactive environment where members collaborate, share insights, and support each other’s development, preparing members for diverse career paths in finance and beyond while encouraging lifelong connections and continued personal growth.

chairs_and_sector_heads.name: Ava Goldsmith
chairs_and_sector_heads.role: PUI Sector Head | Member Experience Chair

pillars.title: Real-World Application
pillars.source_description: At ATG, education translates into action. Members actively manage the club’s $10k portfolio using a variety of long-only strategies

pillars.title: Professional Development
pillars.source_description: Breaking into high finance roles requires more than a solid technical understanding. ATG provides structured support for our members to navigate the recruiting timelines and land top offers

pillars.title: Community
pillars.source_description: ATG cultivates a strong community of people with an interest in Finance, spanning various hobbies, backgrounds, and involvement at Michigan.

placement.heading: Placement
placement.subheading: Our members go on to work at top firms within High Finance and various other industries.
placement.intro: ATG has an exclusive alumni network that our members are encouraged to engage with and maintain contact with for future careers. Below is a snapshot of where our members have begun their careers over recent years.

experiences.title: Pitches
experiences.description: Teams present equity research and stock pitches to the entire club and Investment Committee for prospective addition to the portfolio

experiences.title: Sector Teams
experiences.description: Members are divided into 6 industry verticals to develop sector-specific expertise

experiences.title: Education
experiences.description: Our comprehensive education program takes a distinctive approach: members work through all six Breaking Into Wall Street (BIWS) guides before the end of freshman year. Summer education reinforces and builds on that foundation, so members enter sophomore year fully prepared for technical interviews and recruiting

experiences.title: New York Trek
experiences.description: Travel to New York to visit leading investment banks and gain a closer look at the industry. Meet professionals, learn about different teams and career paths, and ask questions about their work and recruiting experiences. The trek also gives members time to connect with one another beyond campus

experiences.title: Resume + Cover Letter
experiences.description: Work with experienced members to develop polished resumes and cover letters that clearly communicate your strengths. Through peer review and practical feedback, refine your bullet points, highlight relevant experience, and tailor your materials to the roles you are pursuing. Build a strong foundation for internship and full-time applications

experiences.title: Mock Interviews
experiences.description: Extensive behavioral and technical mocks with upperclassmen who have secured offers at top firms and within a recruiting group helping each other out throughout the process

experiences.title: Networking Strategy
experiences.description: Build a thoughtful approach to networking, from writing effective outreach emails to preparing for coffee chats and informational interviews. Learn how to research firms, ask meaningful questions, follow up professionally, and maintain relationships with alumni and industry professionals. Get guidance on firm-specific networking events and use each conversation to deepen your understanding of different career paths
